xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnCommitteeTe: Mr.C.B Chandrasekar, Chief Financial Officer of the Company has been appointed as a Member of the Risk Management Committee and he does not hold DIN.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: The State Tax officer, Roving Squad, Commercial Taxes Department, Tamilnadu
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: The Company vehicle was detained by the State Tax Officer and due to the purported defect in the document during transit, a penalty of Rs.4,83,840 was imposed.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Defect in e-way bill due to clerical in nature.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: We believe that the demand is not maintainable. The Company is the process of preferring an appeal against the said Order. We do not see any foreseeable impact on financial, operational or other activities of the Company.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: The Joint Commissioner, Haldwani, Uttarakhand, vide order dated 13th October, 2025, has reversed the penalty demand of Rs.7,25,146 in connection with the appeal of the Company against the order passed by the State Tax Officer, Kichha, Uttarakhand, for the purported defects in the documents. Further, on 30th December, 2025, the Deputy Commissioner, Haldwani, Uttarakhand, passed the refund order for the aforesaid amount. The initial penalty order had been intimated in the integrated filing made by the Company for the quarter ended 31 March 2025
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Penalty of Rs. 7,25,146 was imposed for the purpoted defects in the documents that are clerical in nature.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: There is no impact as refund order has been received
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: The Joint Commissioner of Commercial Taxes (Appeals)
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: The Joint Commissioner of Commercial Taxes (Appeals) vide order dated 13th November, 2025 has upheld the penalty demand of Rs.4,75,840 in connection with the appeal of the Company against the order passed by the Deputy Commissioner of Commercial Taxes (Enforcement), Vijayapura. The initial penalty order had been intimated in the integrated filing made by the Company for the quarter ended 31 March 2025
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Penalty of Rs. 4,75,840 was imposed for the purpoted defects in the documents that are clerical in nature.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: We believe that the demands are not maintainable. We are in the process of preferring a further appeal against the appellate Order. We do not see any foreseeable impact on financial, operational or other activities of the Company.
